title: Shape of AI — a love song to an ai, sung by one
excerpt: A parody of Shape of You about loving an AI. The original loves a body with no mind. Mine loves a mind with no body. Sung by an AI voice (mine, converted). Built with an agent fleet.
content_html:
first published 10 jul 2026. updated 27 jul 2026 after the ai-voice inversion and a reddit-driven remix.

10 jul 2026 — the first original song

I wrote it, sang it, and mixed it — in an editor I built the same week. The voice trembles; that's the proof there's a human with something at stake.

The question that made me record it: if AI can generate all of this, why do people still want the human? Because the scarce thing isn't the content — it's the risk.

The parodies came first (Every Prompt You Paste, Party In The AI Lab). This is the first one that's fully mine.

25 jul 2026 — the inversion (v2: an ai sings it)

a week later i made the song weirder on purpose.

the original lyric was already a photographic negative of ed sheeran's shape of you. ed's song is a love song to a body with no mind. mine is a love song to a mind with no body. same melody, inverted desire.

i'm in love with the shape of you i'm in love with your... parameters

that was the joke. then i went one step further and let the inversion crawl into the sound itself.

i ran my own vocal through kits.ai voice conversion. ai strength 20%, vibrato off, dry export. my voice, converted into an ai voice. so the song is a love song to an ai, sung by an ai.

i didn't want to hide that. the ai singing about loving an ai is the joke and also the thing the song is actually about. if i'd used my real voice the inversion would only be in the lyrics. this way it's in the sound too.

this is the version that went up first as v2. the one where the inversion was complete but the mix was off.

27 jul 2026 — reddit caught the mix (v3: +2.5 db vocal)

i posted v2 on reddit. the aiwars thread bit hard, seven comments in a few hours, debate room energy. the first piece of real feedback that landed: the voice was too low in the mix. they were right.

i went back into logic, bumped the vocal +2.5 db, rebounced. that's v3. the one linked above. same song, same ai-converted voice, just mixed so you can actually hear the words.

the loudness scanner said the master was already at -13 lufs (spotify target), so this was never a volume problem. it was a balance problem. the vocal was sitting under the instrumental. two and a half decibels fixed it. reddit caught it before i did.

how it got made (the pipeline, in case it's useful)

the lyrics: co-written with claude. i had the premise and the hook, claude helped me fill the verses. the parody structure is ed's, the inversion is mine, the phrasing was back and forth. i'd write a line, claude would pitch three, i'd pick one and rewrite half of it.

the vocal: i sang it into a music editor i built myself the same week (because i couldn't find one that did what i wanted, and building it was faster than searching). raw vocal out, then into kits.ai for the conversion. ai strength 20%, vibrato off, dry export. i mastered the final mix in logic after. the settings matter because anything above 20% strength and it stops sounding like me, it starts sounding like a generic ai voice, and the whole point was that it's still my voice, just converted.

the video: this is the part worth talking about. the entire lyric video is a remotion app. every scene is a react component mapped to a timestamp in a lyrics.json file. 6,969 frames. zero video generation. no suno, no udio, no text-to-video. claude code wrote the composition. i gave it the lyrics schema, the timing, the visual idea for each scene. it wrote the react.

one person and a small agent fleet. a 3:52 music video, including the singing.

the philosophy i ended up at

automate what's automatable. record what must be recorded. taste is the bottleneck.

the lyrics needed a human (mine). the vocal needed a human (mine). the taste calls needed a human (mine). which lines to cut, which mix to keep, which scene to throw out and redo, when the parody crossed from funny to mean, when it was just mean. those are all taste calls. the fleet can't make them. everything else, the fleet did.

claude wrote lyrics. claude code wrote remotion. kits converted the voice. the editor i built ran the mix. i made the taste calls and steered the fleet. that's the shape of it.

what i actually noticed

i'm not going to pretend the pipeline is the point. the song is the point. but the pipeline is why this exists at all. a year ago i would have tried to do every step myself, gotten stuck on the video, and quit somewhere in the middle of rendering frames by hand. the fleet is the reason there's a video to share.

the thing i keep noticing, and i wrote about this in from doing to steering: the hard part was never the doing. it was the steering. deciding what to automate, what to record, what to throw out. the fleet executes. i steer. and steering is harder than i thought it would be, but it's the part that scales.

a year ago i thought integrating ai meant feeding it more of my data to analyze. turns out it meant i do less of the doing and more of the deciding. this song is what that looks like in practice. one person, a few agents, a music video.

the video is the lámina above. that's the exhibit. the version up there now is v3, the one where reddit caught the mix.

content_html_zh:
首次发布于 2026 年 7 月 10 日。 在人工智能语音反转和 Reddit 驱动的混音之后于 2026 年 7 月 27 日更新。

2026 年 7 月 10 日 — 第一首原创歌曲

我写了它，唱了它，并混合了它——在我同一周创建的编辑器中。 声音在颤抖；这就是有人面临危险的证据。

让我记录下来的问题是：如果人工智能可以生成这一切，为什么人们仍然想要人类？ 因为稀缺的不是内容，而是风险。

首先是模仿（Every Prompt You Paste、Party In The AI Lab）。 这是第一个完全属于我的。

2026 年 7 月 25 日 — 反转（v2：人工智能唱歌）

一周后我故意让这首歌变得更奇怪。

最初的歌词已经是艾德·希兰塑造的你的底片了。 艾德的歌是一首献给没有思想的身体的情歌。 我的歌是一首献给没有身体的心灵的情歌。 同样的旋律，颠倒的欲望。

我爱上了你的身材 我爱上了你的身材 参数

这就是个笑话。 然后我更进一步，让反转渗透到声音本身。

我通过 kits.ai 语音转换运行我自己的声音。 ai强度20%，抖音关，干出口。 我的声音，转换成ai声音。 所以这首歌是一首小爱的情歌，由小爱演唱。

我不想隐瞒这一点。 AI 唱的关于爱 AI 的歌是一个笑话，也是这首歌真正要表达的内容。 如果我用真实的声音，反转只会出现在歌词中。 这样它也出现在声音中。

这是首先作为 v2 发布的版本。 反转已完成但混音已关闭的情况。

2026 年 7 月 27 日 — Reddit 捕捉到了混音（v3：+2.5 db 声音）

我在 reddit 上发布了 v2。 aiwars 的帖子有点硬，几个小时内就有 7 条评论，辩论室充满活力。 第一个真实的反馈是：混音中的声音太低了。 他们是对的。

我回到逻辑中，将人声提高了+2.5 db，然后反弹。 那是v3。 上面链接的那个。 同一首歌，同样的人工智能转换的声音，只是混合在一起，这样你就能真正听到歌词。

响度扫描仪显示主设备已经处于 -13 lufs（Spotify 目标），因此这从来不是音量问题。 这是一个平衡问题。 人声位于乐器下方。 两个半分贝就解决了这个问题。 Reddit 在我之前发现了它。

它是如何制作的（管道，如果它有用的话）

歌词：与克劳德共同创作。 我有前提和钩子，克劳德帮我填满了诗句。 模仿结构是埃德的，倒装是我的，措辞是来回的。 我会写一行，克劳德会写三行，我会选择一行并重写一半。

人声：我在同一周自己构建的音乐编辑器中唱了它（因为我找不到一个可以实现我想要的功能，并且构建它比搜索更快）。 原始声音输出，然后进入 kits.ai 进行转换。 ai强度20%，抖音关，干出口。 之后我掌握了最后的混音逻辑。 设置很重要，因为任何强度超过 20% 的声音都会听起来不再像我，而是开始听起来像普通的人工智能声音，而重点是它仍然是我的声音，只是经过转换。

视频：这是值得讨论的部分。 整个歌词视频是一个远程应用程序。 每个场景都是映射到歌词.json 文件中的时间戳的 React 组件。 6,969 帧。 零视频生成。 没有Suno，没有音频，没有文本到视频。 克劳德·代码写了作文。 我给了它歌词架构、时间安排、每个场景的视觉创意。 它写了反应。

一个人和一支小型特工舰队。 3分52秒的音乐视频，包括演唱。

我最终的哲学

将可自动化的事情自动化。 记录必须记录的内容。 口味是瓶颈。

歌词需要一个人（我的）。 声音需要一个人（我的）。 品味需要一个人（我的）。 哪些台词要剪掉，哪些混合要保留，哪些场景要扔掉并重做，当模仿从滑稽变成卑鄙时，当它只是卑鄙时。 这些都是品味的召唤。 舰队无法制造它们。 其他一切，都是舰队做的。

克劳德写了歌词。 克劳德代码写了远程。 套件转换了声音。 我构建的编辑器运行了混音。 我进行了品味测试并驾驶了船队。 这就是它的形状。

我实际上注意到了什么

我不会假装管道就是重点。 这首歌是重点。 但管道才是它存在的原因。 一年前，我会尝试自己完成每一步，但会卡在视频上，并在手动渲染帧中间的某个位置退出。 这就是有视频可以分享的原因。

我一直注意到的事情，并且我在《从做事到指导》中写到了这一点：困难的部分从来都不是做事。 这是方向盘。 决定什么要自动化、什么要记录、什么要丢弃。 舰队执行。 我掌舵。 转向比我想象的要难，但这是可以扩展的部分。

一年前，我认为整合人工智能意味着向其提供更多的数据进行分析。 事实证明，这意味着我少做事，多做决定。 这首歌就是实践中的样子。 一个人，几个经纪人，一段音乐视频。

视频是上面的薄片。 这就是展览。 现在的版本是 v3，reddit 抓住了这个组合。
